title: Superseded initial Pipecat SmallWebRTC harness result

pipecat_smallwebrtc.observed: Peer connection and data channel opened, but the original harness did not record a returned high-energy audio frame before its 15-second whole-case timeout. It had no frame counters.

harness_defects_repaired: The whole-case timeout was 15 seconds despite a 20-pulse sequence with 500 ms inter-pulse gaps and up to 3 seconds receive wait per pulse.
The offer omitted the video m-line assumed by SmallWebRTC's fixed audio/video transceiver ordering.
The harness did not count pipeline input frames, returned client frames, or returned signal frames.
interpretation: This is a recovery record, not a latency measurement or evidence that the Pipecat transport itself cannot pass audio.
